corporate_1984 = [12.65, 12.80, 13.36, 13.64, 14.41, 14.49, 14.25, 13.54, 13.37, 13.02, 12.40, 12.47]

def pearson_correlation(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
    
    sum_sq_x = sum((x[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))
    sum_sq_y = sum((y[i] - mean_y) ** 2 for i in range(n))
    
    denominator = math.sqrt(sum_sq_x * sum_sq_y)
    
    if denominator == 0:
        return 0
    
    return numerator / denominator

# Calculate correlations
corr_1979 = pearson_correlation(treasury_1979, corporate_1979)
corr_1984 = pearson_correlation(treasury_1984, corporate_1984)

def pearson_correlation(x, y):
    """Calculate sample Pearson correlation coefficient"""
    n = len(x)
    
    # Calculate means
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    # Calculate numerator (covariance)
    numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
    
    # Calculate denominator (product of standard deviations)
    sum_sq_x = sum((x[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))
    sum_sq_y = sum((y[i] - mean_y) ** 2 for i in range(n))
    denominator = math.sqrt(sum_sq_x * sum_sq_y)
    
    if denominator == 0:
        return 0
    
    return numerator / denominator

# Calculate correlations

print(f"1984 Correlation: {corr_1984:.10f}")

# Year 1979 is in the 4th column group (columns 10, 11, 12 for Treasury, Corporate, Municipal)
treasury_1979 = [8.43, 8.43, 8.45, 8.44, 8.55, 8.32, 8.35, 8.42, 8.68, 9.44, 9.80, 9.58]
corporate_1979 = [9.47, 9.52, 9.65, 9.69, 9.82, 9.51, 9.47, 9.57, 9.87, 11.17, 11.52, 11.30]

# 1984 data from Treasury Bulletin March 1985, page 48
# Year 1984 is in the 4th column group (columns 10, 11, 12 for Treasury, Corporate, Municipal)
treasury_1984 = [11.82, 12.00, 12.45, 12.65, 13.43, 13.54, 13.36, 12.71, 12.42, 12.04, 11.66, 11.64]
corporate_1984 = [12.65, 12.80, 13.36, 13.64, 14.41, 14.49, 14.25, 13.54, 13.37, 13.02, 12.40, 12.47]

def pearson(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mx, my = sum(x)/n, sum(y)/n
    num = sum((x[i]-mx)*(y[i]-my) for i in range(n))
    den = math.sqrt(sum((x[i]-mx)**2 for i in range(n)) * sum((y[i]-my)**2 for i in range(n)))
    return num/den

r1979 = pearson(treasury_1979, corporate_1979)
r1984 = pearson(treasury_1984, corporate_1984)
print(f'1979 r = {r1979:.10f}')
print(f'1984 r = {r1984:.10f}')
print(f'|r1979 - r1984| = {abs(r1979-r1984):.10f}')
print(f'Final answer: {abs(r1979-r1984):.4f}')
"
